headline: Flame Swordsman
title: Flame Swordsman Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Flame Swordsman. What is it? It is a Level five FIRE Warrior Fusion Monster with one thousand eight hundred attack. What does it do? It is a Fusion of Flame Manipulator and Masaki the Legendary Swordsman, with no extra effect. How do you use it? Fuse the two materials with Polymerization. It appears in Legendary Collection 4, Joey's World. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
